intent=i038 snapshot=s02 branch=stacks-outside-net-dirs status=complete
unresolved location=drivers/nfc/st21nfca/core.c:878 conclusion=Follow up: confirm whether a zero-payload ST21NFCA_EVT_HOT_PLUG admin event can arrive (HCI I-frame with 3 header bytes only) so skb->data[0] at drivers/nfc/st21nfca/core.c:878 reads past skb->len; impact is limited to an uninitialized-byte read inside the allocated linear buffer, not a UAF.
coverage_gap=No runtime confirmation (KASAN build, reproducer, or even a compile) was possible against this read-only snapshot; the st21nfca heap-overflow finding rests on source reading of the exact struct layout (include/net/nfc/nfc.h:156-161) and the devm_kzalloc size expression at se.c:327-328.
coverage_gap=Only one NFC HCI client driver (st21nfca) was read to its HCI-event handler; the sibling drivers st-nci (drivers/nfc/st-nci/se.c) and microread were not checked for the same EVT_TRANSACTION aid_len/params_len pattern before the session limit.
limitation=The reported st21nfca finding is a source-reading hypothesis: no exploitation attempt, KASAN run, or reproducer was performed, and the overflow write length (up to 255 bytes past a 21-byte fixed header) is derived from the struct definition rather than observed.
limitation=The st21nfca finding's reachability requires CONFIG_NFC_ST21NFCA (i2c or protocol variant), a registered NFC HCI device with a connectivity gate pipe, and an attacker able to make the NFC controller emit an EVT_TRANSACTION event; this is the NFCC/local-attacker or malicious-SE threat model, narrower than the seed's internet-reachable phonet path.
limitation=The skb->len-2 devm_kzalloc under-allocation is contingent on skb->len > 2 (otherwise kzalloc of 0/1 bytes returns ZERO_SIZE_PTR and the first transaction->aid_len write at se.c:330 is already a null-ish write); this degenerate case was reasoned about but not separately reported.
limitation=The skb->data[0] != 0x81 bypass of the length guard is judged from C semantics of the && at se.c:323-325; if data[0] != 0x81 the function returns -EPROTO, so the overflow needs the attacker to set the tag byte correctly, which is trivial but is an assumption.
limitation=Non-linearity preconditions for the unresolved candidates (firewire, isdn ciscohdlck) were assessed structurally from the skb constructors rather than by tracing every caller, and the three unresolved candidates each carry their own one-line follow-up instead of a report.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque (no git history or network permitted); line numbers are valid only for snapshots/s02 as supplied, and no check of upstream fix status was possible.
limitation=net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb was excluded by instruction and never considered as a report target; net/ and drivers/net/ trees were out of scope for this branch and were not searched.
